commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path(\"g0-fixture/status.txt\"); s=p.read_text(); assert s.strip()==\"Pendiente\", \"Estado inicial inesperado\"; p.write_text(s.replace(\"Pendiente\", \"Listo\")); assert p.read_text().strip()==\"Listo\"; print(\"g0-fixture/status.txt: Pendiente → Listo; verificado\")'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path(\"g0-fixture/status.txt\"); s=p.read_text(); assert s.strip()==\"Pendiente\", \"Estado inicial inesperado\"; p.write_text(s.replace(\"Pendiente\", \"Listo\")); assert p.read_text().strip()==\"Listo\"; print(\"g0-fixture/status.txt: Pendiente → Listo; verificado\")'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'state=$(<g0-fixture/status.txt)
